description: Agent Readiness: submit one workflow run’s records: the detection or trigger record (kind, rule, deterministic, time), investigation notes, approval records (approver, decision, actions covered) and the actions taken, each with ids, links and timestamps. The signed report says whether the run is auditable end to end, tracing each action through its investigation and approval to the trigger, and names every missing or unlinked record (no approval record, actions with no matching investigation, unknown references) and every timestamp that is missing, unreadable or out of order. Verdict unprovable, gapped or auditable. POST /api/run-record-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-readiness-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-readiness/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

deterministic.description: The trigger fires from a fixed rule.

rule.description: The detection rule or schedule that fired.
